SOLITA Altavas, Aklan Gentlemen [Ladies: This pertains to the letter of Mr. Joel Mayor, President of Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, Municipal Liga Chapter, Altavas, Aklan regarding your alleged capripicious, whimsical, arbitrary and willful refusal to recognize him as Ex-Officio Member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan representing the Liga ng mga Barangay. Per the letter of Mr. Mayor, he was declared as the duly elected President of the Liga ng mga Barangay, Altavas Chapter in an election of officers held last December 7, 2010 pursuant to the Resolution of the National Executive Board, Liga ng mga Barangay ng Pilipinas dated 16 December 2010 and signed by Hon. Ricojudge M. Echiverri, National Liga ng mga Barangay, President. On 17 December 2010, Mr. Mayor took his oath of Office before Aklan Governor Carlito S. Marquez. On 20 December 2010, Mr. Mayor wrote the President of the Provincial Liga ng mga Barangay Edina T. Gelito informing her that he will assume his office as President of Liga ng mga Barangay, Altavas Chapter effective 20 December 2010. Thereafter, thru a letter dated 21 December 2010 Provincial Liga President Gelito confirmed and affirmed the assumption of Mr. Mayor as Liga President, Altavas Chapter. According to Mr. Mayor, he informed you of his assumption as Liga ng mga Barangay President, Altavas Chapter and as Ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan yet, you still did not recognize him for reason that Mayor Denny D. Fedol issued a Memorandum No. 002, dated 04 January 2011, recognizing another person Punong Barangay Hernan E. Catuiran as Liga ng mga Barangay President and that, you also issued a Resolution No. 106 s. 2011 entitled: "A Resolution confirming and Recognizing Hon. Hernan E. Catuiran as President of the Liga ng mga Barangay of the Municipality of Altavas and Ex-Officio Member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan". Hence, the subject letter of Mr. Mayor. In this regard, in line with our general supervision over all Local Government Units, may we remind you of the pertinent provisions of the Local Government Code and the 2010 Constitution and By-Laws of Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, as follows: "Section 494. Ex Officio Membership in Sanggunians. — The duly elected presidents of the Liga at the municipal, city and provincial levels, including the competent cities and municipalities of Metropolitan, Manila shall serve as ex-officio members of the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, and sangguniang

panlalawigan, respectively. They shall serve as such only during their term of office as presidents of the Liga Chapters, which is in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the sanggunian concerned. [Local Government Code]. Section 5. Ex Officio Membership in the Sanggunian (a) The duly elected President of the Liga at the municipal, city and provincial chapters shall serve as Ex-Officio members of the Sangguniang Bayan, Sangguniang Panlungsod, and the Sangguniang Panlalawigan respectively." Also, the Liga ng mga Barangay, National Executive Board rendered a decision declaring the prior election and proclamation of Punong Barangay as the Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter null and void, the dispositive portion of which reads: "WHEREFORE, premises considered, the prior election and proclamation of Punong Barangay Hernan Catuiran as the Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter is hereby declared null and void. It is hereby further declared that Punong Barangay Joel F. Mayor is the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter." In view of the foregoing, it is clear that the duly elected President of Liga at the Municipal Chapter shall serve as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan. Since Mr. Joel Mayor was declared as the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter in the decision rendered by the Liga ng mga Barangay, National Executive Board, he can now assume as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Aklan by operation of law. Please be guided accordingly. LS:94/11 Mr. Joel F. Mayor President Municipal Liga ng mga Barangay Altavas, Chapter Altavas, Aklan A Very truly yours, . JESUS .
